login.title: Partner sign-in
login.intro: Type the email address Hidden Antwerp registered for your business. You'll get a link that signs you in; no password needed.
login.sent: If {email} has access to a partner portal, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once, for 15 minutes.
login.noAccess: Not a partner yet? Get in touch with Hidden Antwerp.
login.verifyTitle: Sign in to the partner portal
login.verifyIntro: Press the button to sign in on this device.

errors.invalid-email: That doesn't look like an email address.
errors.too-many-requests: Too many attempts. Wait a quarter of an hour and try again.
errors.invalid-link: This sign-in link is not valid anymore (used, expired or incomplete). Ask for a new one.
errors.not-allowed: This address no longer has access to a partner portal.
errors.not-configured: Sign-in is not available on this server yet.
errors.offline: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

email.loginSubject: Your Hidden Antwerp partner sign-in link
email.loginBody: Use this link to sign in to your Hidden Antwerp partner portal:
email.loginValid: The link works once, for {minutes} minutes.
email.loginIgnore: Didn't ask for it? Then you can ignore this email: nobody can sign in without the link.
email.inviteSubject: Your access to the Hidden Antwerp partner portal
email.inviteBody: You now have access to the partner portal of {name} at Hidden Antwerp. There you can follow the visitors, sales and commissions of your partner link:
email.inviteHow: Sign in with this email address: you'll receive a one-time sign-in link (no password).

portal.title: Partner portal
portal.linkIntro: Share this link or the QR code with your guests. Purchases made within {days} days after opening it count for you.
portal.campaignHint: Want to compare places or materials? Add a campaign to the link, e.g. {example}.
portal.qrLabel: QR code of your partner link
portal.ruleNote: Changes to the commission only apply to purchases made after the change.

rules.percent-net: {percent} % of the ticket price excluding VAT

stats.title: {from} – {to}
stats.visitorsNote: Counted per link, without personal data.
stats.outstandingNote: Earned, not paid out yet (all periods).
stats.pendingNote: Of which {amount} is still in the 14-day checking period.

sales.title: Sales
sales.empty: No sales through your link in this period.
sales.limited: Showing the latest {count} sales; the totals above cover the whole period.

how.title: How it works
how.attribution: A visitor who opens your link is remembered for {days} days on that device. If they open another partner's link afterwards, that last link counts.
how.paidOnly: Commission is only earned on purchases that are actually paid, and is calculated on the price excluding VAT.
how.refunds: If a purchase is refunded, the commission is cancelled or reduced accordingly.
how.statuses: Each commission is first checked (14-day withdrawal period), then approved, made ready for payout and paid out by bank transfer.
how.privacy: You never see who bought: no names or email addresses, only numbers.
